caption:
A cloud on Mars trails a volcano. It can reach over 1,500 km.

The volcano is Arsia Mons.
This photo shows the volcano, not the cloud.
Wind pulls the cloud downstream into a long tail.

What the astronomers say: The usual way clouds form needs dust, but there is little high on Mars, so the best idea is that dust is not involved.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA26557 (Mars Odyssey, THEMIS)
